claims.text: Equimolar WTaTiVZr has high configurational disorder.
Configurational disorder in equimolar WTaTiVZr produces spatially fluctuating lattice distortions.
The spatially fluctuating lattice distortions act as heterogeneous effective pinning sites for dislocations.
Altered dislocation dynamics in WTaTiVZr produce a more uniform distribution of plastic flow.
More uniformly distributed plastic flow delays crack initiation in WTaTiVZr.
Delayed crack initiation enhances the plastic strain and toughness of WTaTiVZr relative to pure tungsten.
Equimolar WTaTiVZr is a disordered BCC solid solution.
Lattice distortions in WTaTiVZr enhance dislocation pinning.
Lattice distortions promote complex dislocation interactions, including network formation and jogs.
Enhanced pinning and complex dislocation interactions redistribute and delay local stress concentrations.
Pure tungsten has a more uniform lattice than equimolar WTaTiVZr.
The relatively uniform lattice of pure tungsten permits more straightforward and less hindered dislocation motion.
Less hindered dislocation motion in pure tungsten can cause earlier crack initiation under high-stress conditions.
Under high-temperature straining, WTaTiVZr will exhibit a higher density of dislocation-pinning events than pure tungsten.
Under high-temperature straining, WTaTiVZr will exhibit more spatially distributed plasticity than pure tungsten.
WTaTiVZr will have higher uniform elongation than pure tungsten under the specified loading conditions.
WTaTiVZr will initiate cracks later than pure tungsten under the specified loading conditions.
WTaTiVZr will have greater fracture toughness than pure tungsten under the specified loading conditions.
Pure tungsten exhibits less frequent dislocation pinning and a more abrupt transition to fracture than WTaTiVZr under similar high-temperature loading.

The proposed mechanism is expected to apply at high temperatures and strain rates representative of plasma-facing-component service, while its applicability at low temperature or under other loading regimes is uncertain.
